ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

5. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 17

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
